verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine on GitHub. The repo documents downloading model weights with `fetch_models.py`, running `edge0 serve` to expose an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on 127.0.0.1:8000, and using local CLI, daemon and desktop builds across macOS, Windows, Android and iOS, so the core product runs entirely on the user's own hardware. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and explicit evidence of the license terms governing self-hosting.
